question: Should Workspaces permanently support `builtin:chart` as a first-party trusted widget rather than direct chart use through the existing custom-widget path?
rationale: The branch creates a new maintained user-facing widget contract; tests can establish implementation quality but cannot decide whether that capability belongs in the bundled product surface.

options.title: Adopt Trusted Charts
options.body: Sponsor `builtin:chart` as a maintained Workspaces capability after locale synchronization and direct UI proof are complete.

options.title: Keep Charts Custom
options.body: Decline the bundled widget and continue directing chart authors to the existing custom-widget mechanism.

recommendation.title: Adopt Trusted Charts
recommendation.body: Sponsor `builtin:chart` as a maintained Workspaces capability after locale synchronization and direct UI proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They hold the strongest available Workspaces feature-series context and can route the proposal to the appropriate repository decision-maker.
